# ESPACIO — Luxury Interior Design & Architecture Studio

> ESPACIO is Hyderabad's premier luxury interior design and turnkey execution studio. Fusing 40+ years of structural legacy with bespoke interior architecture, high-precision modular joinery, and direct material sourcing.

## Core Navigation & Services
- [Home Page](https://www.theespacio.in/): Overview of bespoke interior projects, statistics, and design philosophy.
- [Services](https://www.theespacio.in/services): Full-home turnkey interiors, commercial fitouts, modular kitchens, and renovations.
- [Projects Portfolio](https://www.theespacio.in/projects): Case studies of luxury villas, penthouses, and residences in Hyderabad (Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, Gachibowli).
- [Spaces & Room Architecture](https://www.theespacio.in/what-we-do): Room-by-room architectural transformations and before/after comparisons.
- [Materials Library](https://www.theespacio.in/products): Direct warehouse supply of WPC wall panels, polygranite sheets, and acrylic fluted louvers.
- [About Legacy](https://www.theespacio.in/about): 4-generation structural engineering legacy spanning Mantana Constructions and Mastana Infra.
- [Contact & Free Estimate](https://www.theespacio.in/contact): Consultation booking and instant interior project cost estimates.

## Contact & Location
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India (Jubilee Hills / Gachibowli / Aziznagar Warehouse)
- Specialization: Turnkey Luxury Interiors, Modular Kitchens, Acoustic Commercial Spaces, Material Supply
